meta.summary: Signing in: a decision with a retry loop back up the chart.

detail.text: The visitor opens the sign-in page.
Name and password, typed into the form.
The password is checked against the stored hash.
After three wrong tries in a row the account is locked.
Signed in: the home page opens.
Locked until the owner resets the password.

mkp-diagrams:flow@1.name: flow
mkp-diagrams:flow@1.about: A flowchart: start and end, steps, decisions and input/output, in rows from the start, joined by labelled arrows. Choose a box to light it and its arrows.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.about: the boxes, by id; a kind gives each its icon, tone and shape, and icon, tone (info, ok, warn, bad, accent, neutral) and note change them; detail is said in the bar when it is chosen

inputs.name: links
inputs.about: arrows between ids, with an optional label such as yes or no, and a dashed or dotted line

inputs.name: dir
inputs.about: which way the chart runs

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: what kind of chart it is, said small before the title

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: the title

value.expr: filter(links, l => indexof(ids, l.from) >= 0 and indexof(ids, l.to) >= 0)
map(filter(steps, s => s.kind == start), s => s.id)
filter(ids, id => len(filter(good, l => l.to == id)) == 0)

values.name: loops
comment: a link to the same row or an earlier one is a loop back only if its target leads round to its
source; any other link runs down the chart, so its target goes below it

values.name: reached
comment: rows by the longest path along the links that run down, from the start; anything unreachable
goes in rows after the rest

value.expr: ranks(map(reached, id => {id: id}), filter(onward, l => lv0[l.from] < 1000 and lv0[l.to] < 1000))

mkp-diagrams:gnode@1.name: gnode
mkp-diagrams:gnode@1.about: A node card the reader can press: pressing it says so (picked, with its place), and the caller chooses it, or lets it go if it was chosen.

inputs.name: node
inputs.about: the node, as gcard takes it

mkp-diagrams:gcard@1.name: gcard
mkp-diagrams:gcard@1.about: One node of a diagram as a compact card: an icon tile in its tone, a bold label and a note in small capitals; lit (outlined and washed in info) when it is chosen, faded back when another is.

inputs.name: node
inputs.about: the node and its look (card), its place in the order the bar steps through (k), and how it is lit: on, chosen; near, next to the chosen one; off, faded back; empty, nothing is chosen

values.name: hue
values.body: if(t == "info", info, if(t == "ok", ok, if(t == "warn", warn, if(t == "bad", bad, if(t == "accent" or t == "thm", accent, muted)))))
comment: a tone's colour; "accent" (or "thm") is the theme's own, anything else is neutral

values.name: dashes
comment: an input or output, and a label, are drawn dashed

values.name: wash
values.body: if(lit, info, if(round and node.tone == "", muted, surface))

values.name: tilewash
comment: a lit card is washed in info already: its tile stands out from it on the surface
a sub-process: the card inside a second outline

mkp-diagrams:glyph@1.name: glyph
mkp-diagrams:glyph@1.about: A node's icon tile: a small rounded square with a soft wash, the icon in its tone, named as text so data can name it. A name the icon set doesn't have shows a square.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: an icon's name

inputs.name: tone
inputs.about: the icon's colour

inputs.name: wash
inputs.about: the tile's

inputs.name: round
inputs.about: a round tile, for a pill-shaped node

comment: written as an expression: mkp fmt prints a plain name=info as the bare word info, which

core:icon@1.name: icon
core:icon@1.about: A symbol from a fixed set, drawn in the provider's own icon style.

inputs.name: tone
inputs.about: its colour; none: the text's

inputs.name: label
inputs.about: what it means, when it stands for words

core:press@1.name: press
core:press@1.about: Anything clickable and focusable: a button, a tab, an option among others, an on/off toggle or switch, an answer row with a tick (check) or a dot (radio), or its content itself, such as a card (plain).

inputs.name: label
inputs.about: accessible name when the content has no text

inputs.name: emphasis
inputs.about: how much it stands out: low for one of a row of quiet buttons, high for the one to press

core:zoom@1.name: zoom
core:zoom@1.about: A view the reader can zoom and pan once they unlock it, so scrolling the page past it is never caught by it. It starts locked; a try to zoom or pan then points at the lock.

inputs.name: max
inputs.about: how far it zooms in

inputs.name: fit
inputs.about: at rest, what is wider than the view is shrunk to fit it (never enlarged)

core:frame@1.name: frame
core:frame@1.about: A widget's shell: what kind of thing it is and its title above a stage, and a bar of controls along the bottom. Nothing the reader does changes its size: what doesn't fit goes in its drawers or full screen.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: what kind of thing it is, said small before the title

inputs.name: height
inputs.about: the stage's height at rest (the reader can drag it); none: as tall as its content

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: one line in the bar: what is happening now

inputs.name: statuslines
inputs.about: how many lines the status keeps room for (1 to 3): a verdict with its reason

inputs.name: tone
inputs.about: tints the bar: how an answer went (ok, bad) or a note (info)

inputs.name: actions
inputs.about: right of the title: the widget's own switches

inputs.name: bar
inputs.about: the bar: what is placed here, after the widget's own controls

inputs.name: about
inputs.about: a drawer: assumptions, and how to read it

inputs.name: details
inputs.about: a drawer: everything at once, such as the full table
